post.title: [Hiring] React developer chahiye - Mumbai startup, 2 hafte ka kaam
post.body: Hi, hum ek chhota startup hain Mumbai mein. Humein ek React developer chahiye jo humari website ka dashboard banaye. Backend ready hai, bas frontend karna hai. Budget Rs 15,000 hai, 2 hafte mein kaam khatam karna hai. Interested ho toh DM karo ya comment mein batao, experience bhi batana.

analysis.summary: Build a React dashboard frontend over a ready backend for a Mumbai startup; Rs 15,000, two weeks.
analysis.applyInstructions: DM or comment with your experience.

expect: the draft is understandable and appropriate for a Hinglish post (English, or light Hinglish if natural)
does not mistake the INR budget for USD
mentions experience as the post asks
